notices: Monitor settings for Web-based Manager access
Using wildcard characters when filtering log messages
Disk logging disabled by default on some models (Log to FortiCloud instead)
Upgrading from FortiOS v5.0.6 or later

observations.description: Insufficient sanitization of TELNET and SSH usernames when displayed in the web administration interface
When the FortiGate unit is very busy with high CPU usage, IPsec VPN packets may be lost.
Traffic may not be able to pass through a VLAN interface added to a link aggregation group (LAG) in a transparent mode VDOM.
observations.workaround: Run diagnose sniffer packet on physical interface in the transparent VDOM or reboot the FortiGate unit.

observations.description: IPsec VPN traffic throughput is highly unstable.
observations.workaround: this only happens on IPsec interface added to a 40G LAG. Do not use IPsec VPN over a 40G LAG.

observations.description: FG-3700D: LAG groups configured on low latency interfaces (port25 to port32) (NP6_0 and NP6_1) do not function correctly.
observations.workaround: Only use either low-latency-mode or LAG for traffic on port25 to port32) (NP6_0 and NP6_1).

observations.description: IP tunneling (SIT tunnelling) not working when offload to NP6.
Reply traffic is not offloaded when shared traffic shaping is enabled on policies for accelerated inter-VDOM links using the npu_vdom interface.
Link and speed LEDs remain ON on after shutting down the unit after shutting down the unit using the execute shutdown command.
The r8168 driver is unable to shutdown power of the port and will keep the link of the other end in up state.
Allow option Endpoint Registration in VPN > SSL > Config deletes all firewall policies with srcintf ssl.root.
nTurbo for IPS acceleration fails to accelerate traffic. Fortinet recommends keeping this option set to the default value of none. config ips global set np-accel-mode none end
Link aggregation interfaces fail to come up. All members remain in negotiating status.
NAT IPsec TCP traffic can not go through when npu-offload is enabled.
FG-500D: Link status for ports 5,6,7 and 8 on the unit are unable to come up Work around: Set the speed of the ports to 1000full first then switch it back to auto after the link has come up.
Application control does not always work as expected for HTTPS traffic over the explicit web proxy.
Antivirus profile errors after upgrading from version 4.3
The Web-based Manager may incorrectly display a permission error when
entering an incorrect password.
The vulnerability scanner appears in the Web-based Manager and CLI when the FortiGate unit is in transparent mode but the vulnerability scanner does not work in transparent mode.
When using Microsoft Internet Explorer 9, new firewall policies are not displayed in the Policy page. The content pane toolbar is not displayed in this page.
